entities.summary: Bhakti Kulkarni is an Indian chess player. She received the FIDE titles of Woman Grandmaster (WGM) in 2012 and International Master (IM) in 2019. She won the women's edition of National Premier Chess Championship in both 2018 and 2019 consecutively. She is a recipient of the Arjuna Award for her contribution to chess.
